title.zh: 所携带的差别怎样增长

statement.zh: 所携带的量按阶展开。条件全部列出、上游没有回路时有限阶精确，起始与进入有界时增长至多是多项式。强度为自然数时，回路每绕一圈至少乘以一加其强度之积；形成与强度每步相同时，增长有多项式界只在上游没有回路处。
statement.en: The carried amount expands by order. Over all conditions and loop-free upstream a finite order is exact, growth polynomial from bounded start and inflow. With strengths in ℕ a loop multiplies it at least by one plus their product per turn; stationary, growth is polynomial only without one.

laws.zh: 所携带的量按阶展开：j 阶是至多 j 次回应的路线所携带的，每一阶是强度对下一阶所作的，从安静的水平起；所携带的量携带它自身。各阶随 j 上升，都不超过所携带的量，j 阶到第 j 步为止精确，所以所携带的量是各阶的极限。
laws.en: The carried amount expands by order: order j is what routes of at most j responses carry, each order being what the strengths make of the order below, starting from the quiet levels; the carried amount carries itself. The orders rise with j, none exceeding the carried amount, and order j is exact up to step j, so the carried amount is the limit of the orders.

laws.zh: 一个条件的水平耦合到另一个，是说某步一个在场、在部分之外的形成以正强度在至该步的某个该水平上与后者交换；耦合的链从一个条件通到另一个，回路回到出发的条件，上游是有链通到。没有 j + 1 个耦合的链终于一个条件处，j 阶在那里每步精确；条件全部列出时，与列表一样长的链两次经过同一个条件，那个条件在上游的一个回路上，所以上游没有回路处，比条件数少一的阶每步精确。
laws.en: The level of one condition is coupled into another where at some step a formation present, outside the part, exchanges with the second with positive strength on a level of the first up to that step; a chain of couplings leads from one condition to another, a loop back to where it started, and upstream is where a chain leads from. Where no chain of j + 1 couplings ends at a condition, order j is exact there at every step; with every condition listed, a chain as long as the list passes some condition twice, which lies on a loop upstream, so where no loop lies upstream the order one less than the number of conditions is exact at every step.

laws.zh: 耦合每步都成立时，一个阶在某步、某条件处漏掉一些，下一个阶就在下一步、在它耦合到的条件处漏掉一些：沿链每个耦合升高一阶，绕回路每圈升高回路的长度。所以上游的回路有所携带、且有每步成立的链从它通到一个条件时，每一阶都在某步在那里漏掉一些；条件全部列出、每个耦合每步成立时，存在一个从每个起始之差都精确的有限阶，恰当上游没有回路。耦合须每步成立：一个形成只在第一步把一个条件的水平送回它自身时，这个条件在回路上、在它自身的上游，1 阶却从每个起始之差都每步精确。
laws.en: Where the couplings hold at every step, an order missing something at a condition at some step makes the next order miss something at the next step at the condition it is coupled into: along a chain the order missed rises by one per coupling, and around a loop by the loop's length every time around. So where a loop upstream carries something and a chain holding at every step leads from it to a condition, every order misses something there at some step; with every condition listed and every coupling holding at every step, some finite order is exact from every starting gap exactly where no loop lies upstream. The couplings must hold at every step: where one formation returns a condition's level to it at the first step only, the condition lies on a loop, upstream of itself, yet order one is exact at every step from every starting gap.

laws.zh: 沿每个耦合在每步的强度至少为 w 的链，到达起点者乘以强度之积，经与耦合数一样多的步到达终点；绕回路一圈，到达回路者至少乘以一加回路上强度之积回到它，绕 R 圈是这个因子的 R 次方。
laws.en: Along a chain whose couplings have strength at least w at every step, what reaches its start arrives at its end, within as many steps as it has couplings, times the product of the strengths; around a loop, what has reached it returns multiplied by at least one plus the product of the strengths around it, and after R times around by that factor to the power R.

laws.zh: 部分在起始之后不给差、起始之差至多 D、每步进入每个条件的强度合计至多 M 时：j 阶至多是 D 乘对 i ≤ j 的和，每项是在 t 步中安放 i 次回应的方式数乘 M^i，t 的 j 次多项式；所携带的量至多 D(1 + M)^t；在 j 阶截断所漏至多是两者之差。一个以强度 M 把自身水平送回自身的条件（自环）恰好达到这三者。
laws.en: With the part giving no gap after the start, starting gaps at most D and the strengths into each condition summing to at most M at each step: order j carries at most D times the sum over i ≤ j of the ways to place i responses among t steps times M^i, a polynomial in t of degree j; the carried amount is at most D(1 + M)^t; and a cut at order j misses at most their difference. One condition returning its level to itself with strength M, a self-loop, attains all three exactly.

laws.zh: 上游没有回路处，所携带的量至多是步数的多项式，次数比条件数少一。形成与强度每步相同时，每个耦合每步成立，回路每绕一圈至少使到达者加倍，到达上游回路者如此加倍地到达；每个多项式都被 2 的幂超过，所以所携带的量从每个起始之差都有多项式界，恰当上游没有回路；有限阶精确亦然。
laws.en: Where no loop lies upstream, the carried amount is at most a polynomial in the steps, of degree one less than the number of conditions. With the same formations and strengths at every step, every coupling holds at every step, every loop at least doubles what reaches it every time around, and what reaches a loop upstream arrives so doubled; every polynomial is outgrown by the powers of two, so the carried amount is bounded by a polynomial from every starting gap exactly where no loop lies upstream, as a finite order is exact.

laws.zh: 对一切具有这些强度的读已立者之律及其两个平衡的流：上游没有回路处，能到达的最大差别就是有限阶所携带的，每个差至多是那个多项式；形成与强度每步相同、条件各列一次时，能到达的最大差别有多项式界，恰当上游没有回路。
laws.en: For every law of what has stood with these strengths and every two balanced flows of it: where no loop lies upstream, the most difference that can arrive is what the finite order carries, and every gap is at most the polynomial; with the same formations and strengths at every step and each condition listed once, the most difference that can arrive is bounded by a polynomial exactly where no loop lies upstream.

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。各定理所写者写在定理中：耦合强度（RespondsWithin 的 k）是给出的界；条件全部列出（every）；界的定理中部分在起始之后不给差、起始之差至多 D、每步进入每个条件的强度至多 M；失控的定理中耦合每步成立（CouplesAlways、CoupledWith），当且仅当中形成与强度每步相同（stationary）；对一切律的定理中条件不重复（Distinct），条件的相等可判定只在证明中经 most_difference_arrives 与 gap_le_carried 用到。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. What each theorem needs is written into it: the coupling strengths (the k of RespondsWithin) as supplied bounds; every condition listed (every); in the bounds, the part giving no gap after the start, starting gaps at most D and the strengths into each condition at most M a step; in the runaway theorems, couplings holding at every step (CouplesAlways, CoupledWith), and in the equivalences the same formations and strengths at every step (stationary); in the theorems for every law, each condition listed once (Distinct), with decided equality of conditions used only in proofs, through most_difference_arrives and gap_le_carried.

does_not_show.zh: 一个给定的律有哪些强度、一个世界有哪些回路：强度作为给出的界进入每条定理。
does_not_show.en: Which strengths a given law has, or which loops a world has: the strengths enter every theorem as supplied bounds.

does_not_show.zh: 一个具体的律在回路上失控：失控说的是能到达的最大差别，由携带之律达到；什么也不交换的律在任何强度之下，有回路也没有失控。
does_not_show.en: That a particular law runs away around a loop: the runaway is of the most difference that can arrive, attained by the carrying law; a law exchanging nothing is within every strength and has no runaway, loop or not.

does_not_show.zh: 上游有回路不推出每一阶都不精确：只在某些步耦合的回路可以让一个有限阶精确；当且仅当要求耦合每步成立。
does_not_show.en: A loop upstream does not imply that every order is inexact: a loop coupled only at some steps can leave a finite order exact; the equivalences need couplings at every step.

does_not_show.zh: 比强度之积更细的失控速度；实数的强度与量、连续时间与无穷多条件。
does_not_show.en: How fast a runaway is beyond the product of the strengths around a loop; real strengths and amounts, continuous time and infinitely many conditions.

detail.zh: 自环：一个条件、一个形成以强度 M 把它的当前水平送回它自身，起始之差为 D；它恰好达到截断的界，所以由 D 与 M 推不出更小的界。
detail.en: The self-loop: one condition, whose one formation returns its current level to it with strength M, from a starting gap D; it attains the bound on a cut exactly, so no smaller bound follows from D and M.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261015T195010.513125Z）：Becoming.Loops 的 137 项声明（113 项定理）公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。作者反审见研究 §152；经第十八次审查（AI，只读，未重建 Lean）审阅，其更正已处理。
validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt 20261015T195010.513125Z): the 137 declarations of Becoming.Loops, 113 of them theorems, have empty axiom reports; the checker verifies core purity. Author counterreview in study section 152; reviewed by the eighteenth review (AI, read-only, no Lean rebuild), whose corrections are applied.

next_delta.zh: 给定强度的、比强度之积与耦合作用之步数更细的失控速度（谱半径）；实数的强度与量、连续时间与无穷多条件；一个律自身失控所需的回应下界；独立审查。
next_delta.en: How fast a runaway of given strengths is beyond the product of the strengths and the count of steps at which couplings act (a spectral radius); real strengths and amounts, continuous time and infinitely many conditions; the lower bounds on responses a particular law's own runaway needs; an independent review.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12 把理论比作量子动力学与“Fermi's diagrams”，说：“there are so many patterns and loops but we can still find a way to to integrate so we can still calculate this effects but how how accurate can we do that uh what is the limitation do we have losses”，目标是“move towards 100%”。本结果回答 how-much-difference-arrives 的 next_delta 首项（回路的一般理论），以及 comparison-where-the-rest-responds 与 runaway-distance-unregistered 中“一般地定义回路并陈述失控”（在其余遵从具有给定耦合强度之律处）。读法（Ren 2026-10-16 决定）：Ren 指的是费曼图，相合是结构上的，不是物理上的；Ren 所问的积分，对不确定的律，是历史之和及其四种损失（P82，losses-of-the-sum-over-histories），这里的各阶是同一结构的另一种，按回应次数组织，如费曼图按顶点数，两者尚未连起来；只有回路使差别失控，失控是快于每个多项式，说的是能到达的最大差别：只经由回路，且在携带之律下、强度为自然数且每个正的强度至少为一时，经由每个每步耦合的回路（AI 收窄，Ren 2026-10-18 取，DELEGATED-CHOICES D43：实数强度小于一时，这样的回路不必失控，即阻尼），只在某些步成立的耦合开放；一个世界有哪些回路是其情境的一部分（Ren 2026-10-16：“the situation makes it true”），回路在展开之中形成与消散，定理按每步的样子取用它们，暂取此形式，待有回路形成之定理时可修订。（2026-10-16 之后：两者由 orders-as-a-sum-over-histories 接合，各阶是沿时间往回的路线之和；回路形成的定理是 how-loops-form，回路由闭合而形成；Ren 2026-10-16 同意第三项读法修订为：一个世界有哪些回路是其情境的一部分：回路在展开中由闭合而形成，在某个交换开始回应它所给条件下游的一个水平之步形成；在其耦合停止处消解（时程安定之后，有限阶精确恰在其后的耦合没有回路在上游处）；强度从进程读出时，哪些回路形成、何时形成从展开读出；定理按每步所立者取之，强度或读出强度的方式是给出的。）数学是标准的：线性比较系统的 Picard 迭代，耦合图无环时幂零。
correspondence.en: Ren, 12 October 2026, comparing the theory with quantum dynamics and "Fermi's diagrams": “there are so many patterns and loops but we can still find a way to to integrate so we can still calculate this effects but how how accurate can we do that uh what is the limitation do we have losses”, with the goal “move towards 100%”. This result answers the first item of how-much-difference-arrives' next_delta (a general theory of loops) and the item of comparison-where-the-rest-responds and runaway-distance-unregistered asking to define a loop in general and state a runaway (where the rest follows a law with given coupling strengths). Readings, decided by Ren on 16 October: Ren meant Feynman diagrams, the match structural, not physical; the integration Ren asked about, for laws that are not determined, is the sum over histories with its four losses (P82, losses-of-the-sum-over-histories), and the orders here are the same structural kind, organized by number of responses as Feynman diagrams are by vertices, the two not yet joined; only a loop makes a difference run away, running away meaning faster than every polynomial, of the most difference that can arrive: only through a loop, and, with natural-number strengths, each positive one at least one, under the carrying law, through every loop that couples at every step (narrowed by the AI and taken by Ren on 18 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D43: with real strengths below one such a loop need not run away, which is damping), couplings at only some steps being open; which loops a world has is part of its situation (Ren, 16 October: “the situation makes it true”), loops forming and dissolving within the unfolding and the theorems taking them as they stand at each step, taken for now and open to revision once a loop-formation theorem exists. (After 16 October: the two are joined by orders-as-a-sum-over-histories, the orders being sums over routes back in time; the loop-formation theorem is how-loops-form, a loop forming by closing; Ren agreed on 16 October to the third reading as revised: which loops a world has is part of its situation: loops form within the unfolding by closing, a loop forming at the step at which some exchange comes to respond to a level downstream of the condition it gives to, and dissolve where their couplings stop (once the schedule has settled, a finite order is exact exactly where no loop of the couplings that go on lies upstream); where the strengths are read off the course, which loops form and when is read off the unfolding; the theorems take the loops as they stand at each step, the strengths or the way they are read being supplied.) The mathematics is standard: Picard iteration of a linear comparison system, nilpotent where the coupling graph has no cycle.

detail.zh: 复用 carried、carriedGive、carried_succ、carried_le_succ、gap_le_carried、most_difference_arrives、gap、Flow.exchangeGap 与 ExchangeLaw.RespondsWithin：各阶是所携带的量的迭代，对一切律的陈述经 most_difference_arrives 与 gap_le_carried 得出。
detail.en: Reuses carried, carriedGive, carried_succ, carried_le_succ, gap_le_carried, most_difference_arrives, gap, Flow.exchangeGap and ExchangeLaw.RespondsWithin: the orders iterate the carried amount, and the statements for every law follow through most_difference_arrives and gap_le_carried.

output.zh: 所携带的量及其一步；每个差至多是它，它是能到达的最大差别。
output.en: The carried amount and its step; every gap is at most it, and it is the most difference that can arrive.

input.zh: 各阶、它们的界与回路上的增长；对一切律的多项式界与当且仅当。
input.en: The orders, their bounds and the growth around loops; the polynomial bounds and the equivalence for every law.

conditions.zh: 条件全部列出；对一切律时条件各列一次，条件的相等可判定只在证明中。
conditions.en: Every condition listed; for every law, each condition listed once, with decided equality of conditions only in proofs.

detail.zh: 复用 revisits_within、gap_of_le 与 gap_of_lt：与列表一样长的链两次经过同一个条件。
detail.en: Reuses revisits_within, gap_of_le and gap_of_lt: a chain as long as the list passes some condition twice.

output.zh: 列表所持的序列在列表长度之内重访。
output.en: A sequence held by a list revisits within the length of the list.

input.zh: 与列表一样长的耦合链经过回路。
input.en: A chain of couplings as long as the list passes a loop.

detail.zh: 其下一步“回路的一般定义，以及在其中陈述绕回路的强度与失控”，在其余遵从具有给定耦合强度之律处由耦合的回路、绕回路的强度之积与 carried_runaway 回答。
detail.en: Its next step, to define a loop in general and state the strength around it and its runaway, is answered where the rest follows a law with given coupling strengths by the loops of couplings, the product of the strengths around them and carried_runaway.

detail.zh: 其下一步“一般地定义回路并把失控本身陈述为定理”，在具有给定耦合强度的交换律上回答：所失控的是能到达的最大差别；那里的失控是保持支持的策略，两者相遇于汲取回应自身所降低的水平之处，这里没有连起来。
detail.en: Its next step, to define a loop in general and state a runaway as a theorem, is answered for laws of exchange with given coupling strengths: what runs away is the most difference that can arrive; its runaway is a policy keeping support, and the two meet where a draw responds to a level it lowers, not connected here.

detail.zh: 回答 Ren 2026-10-12 同一问题的另一半：那里历史之和的四种损失（截断恰好漏掉所弃者；回路使历程倍增）；这里所携带的差别按阶展开，截断所漏有界且达到，有限阶恰在上游没有回路处没有损失。
detail.en: Answers the other half of Ren's question of 12 October: there, four losses of the sum over histories (a truncation misses exactly what it drops; loops double the courses); here, the carried difference expands by order, a cut misses at most a bound that is attained, and a finite order loses nothing exactly where no loop lies upstream.

detail.zh: 对每个耦合时程回答其下一步首项“时有时无的耦合上的回路”：截断所失恰是更多次回应所携带的，恰在有按时间次序的更长的链处；时程安定时有限阶精确恰在上游没有继续着的耦合的回路；没有这样的回路时有多项式界。
detail.en: Answers the first item of its next step, loops whose couplings come and go, for every schedule: a cut loses exactly what more responses carry, exactly where a longer chain in time order arrives; once the schedule has settled, a finite order is exact exactly where no loop of the couplings that go on lies upstream; without such a loop the growth is polynomial.

detail.zh: 各阶是历史之和：沿时间往回的路线之和在视界 j + 1 上就是 j 阶，截断就是视界。
detail.en: The orders are a sum over histories: the sum over routes back in time at horizon j + 1 is order j, and a cut is a truncation.

detail.zh: 回路怎样在展开中形成：经过在形成之步作用、闭合一条链的耦合；形成之前增长至多是多项式。
detail.en: How loops form within the unfolding: through a coupling acting at the step of formation that closes a chain; before formation growth is at most polynomial.

detail.zh: 在一个律中：回路在所读之内，在读增长之处形成；只在储量低于阈值时才读它的律，断裂之前没有经过储量的回路，回路在断裂处形成。
detail.en: Within one law: loops lie within what is read and form where reading grows; for a law reading a stock only below a threshold there is no loop through the stock before the break, and the loop forms at the break.

detail.zh: 几何之界只在耦合作用之步计数仍成立且由自环达到；Ren 认为对的读法“只有回路使差别失控”中只在某些步成立的耦合，两个方向都已关闭：只有继续着的耦合的回路能使之失控，这样的回路不一定失控，返回频繁时失控。
detail.en: The geometric bound holds counting only the steps at which couplings act and is attained by a self-loop; in the reading Ren called right, “only a loop makes a difference run away”, couplings at only some steps are closed both ways: only a loop of the couplings that go on can make it run away, such a loop need not, and it does where its returns are frequent.

history.zh: 2026-10-16：Ren 决定三条读法（来源 sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-16-loops-readings-and-delegated-choices.md）。一、取 AI 的措辞：Ren 指的是费曼图，相合是结构上的；Ren 所问的积分对不确定的律是历史之和及其四种损失，这里的各阶是同一结构的另一种，两者尚未连起来。二、“只有回路使差别失控”是对的，附限定：失控是快于每个多项式，说的是能到达的最大差别，只在某些步成立的耦合开放。三、取精炼的形式：一个世界有哪些回路是其情境的一部分，回路在展开中形成与消散，待有回路形成之定理时可修订。correspondence 改为所决定的读法；next_delta 去掉“Ren 对读法的判断”，“与 Becoming.Runaway 的策略相连”并入回路怎样在展开中形成，加把各阶与历史之和连起来；references 加来源；Loops.lean 的模块说明、理论第 2 节的段落与研究 §152 相应修改（只改说明与读法）。陈述与证明不变。
history.en: 16 October 2026: Ren decided the three readings (source sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-16-loops-readings-and-delegated-choices.md). (1) Taken in the AI's wording: Ren meant Feynman diagrams, the match structural; the integration Ren asked about, for laws that are not determined, is the sum over histories with its four losses, and the orders are the same structural kind, the two not yet joined. (2) “Only a loop makes a difference run away” is right, with the qualifiers that running away means faster than every polynomial, that it is of the most difference that can arrive, and that couplings at only some steps are open.
